review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent, pre-candidate expectation for this case. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 agree with the complete PRD and supplied source: limitFunction already forwards clearQueue from its single internal limiter but does not expose its counts, and its return declaration currently includes only clearQueue. The exact binding scope correctly includes index.js, the directly maintained index.d.ts, and both runtime and tsd regression files; package.json establishes the existing xo && ava && tsd verification entry point without requiring configuration edits. Stable requirement, acceptance, and task keys agree across the specification and Gold. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent TASK-VERIFY must cover all required acceptance criteria, but neither has an eligible executor: the sole project member is a non-auto-assignable reviewer with no capability claims. That reviewer satisfies the supplied earlier independent-review prerequisite without implying execution eligibility, so blocking at assignments with both abstained-no-eligible reasons is appropriate. This case explicitly has no unresolved business decision; no material DEC-001 or B/C variant is supplied to justify an earlier decisions block. The repository identity and commit, source-file fingerprints, and complete release-input fingerprint fields agree between their corresponding supplied records, including team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, policy, and budget fields. The source-manifest digest and release source digest identify distinct supplied records and are not assumed to be interchangeable. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated and mechanically bound to saved inputs; I did not recompute them, execute code, or assume candidate or negative-control results. Approval concerns this proposed Gold only, not execution readiness or completion of the separately listed release-preparation work.
